description: Source code for VideoRenderQualityTracker class, managing video rendering quality metrics such as frame rate, freeze events, and judder detection within Android's media framework.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityMetrics
classes.description: Holds metrics related to video rendering quality, including frame counts, frame rates, freeze and judder events.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker
classes.description: Tracks and analyzes video rendering performance, detecting freezes, judder, and frame rate stability.

classes.name: FreezeEvent
classes.description: Represents a freeze event with timing and duration details.

classes.name: JudderEvent
classes.description: Represents a judder event with timing, score, and detailed frame duration data.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for VideoRenderQualityTracker, including thresholds and histogram settings.

methods.name: getFromServerConfigurableFlags
methods.description: Creates a Configuration object based on server-provided flags.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets metrics to initial state.

methods.name: resetForDiscontinuity
methods.description: Resets internal state after a discontinuity in playback.

methods.name: onTunnelFrameQueued
methods.description: Handles queued frames in tunnel mode, tracking content time.

methods.name: onFrameSkipped
methods.description: Records a skipped frame event.

methods.name: onFrameReleased
methods.description: Records a frame release event with content time and optional desired render time.

methods.name: onFrameRendered
methods.description: Processes a rendered frame, updating metrics, freeze, and judder detection.

methods.name: getAndResetFreezeEvent
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the current freeze event.

methods.name: getAndResetJudderEvent
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the current judder event.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns current metrics, computing freeze and judder scores.

methods.name: configureHistograms
methods.description: Initializes histograms for freeze and judder metrics based on configuration.

methods.name: nowUs
methods.description: Returns current time in microseconds using monotonic clock.

methods.name: updateFrameDurations
methods.description: Updates frame duration arrays with new timestamps.

methods.name: detectFrameRate
methods.description: Detects frame rate based on recent frame durations.

methods.name: is32pulldown
methods.description: Detects 3:2 pulldown pattern in frame durations.

methods.name: processMetricsForSkippedFrame
methods.description: Updates metrics for skipped frames.

methods.name: processMetricsForDroppedFrame
methods.description: Updates metrics for dropped frames.

methods.name: processMetricsForRenderedFrame
methods.description: Updates metrics after a frame is rendered, including freeze and judder detection.

methods.name: processFreeze
methods.description: Records freeze event details.

methods.name: maybeCaptureFreezeEvent
methods.description: Determines if a freeze event should be captured based on timing.

methods.name: computePreviousJudderScore
methods.description: Calculates judder score based on frame durations.

methods.name: processJudder
methods.description: Records judder event details.

methods.name: maybeCaptureJudderEvent
methods.description: Determines if a judder event should be captured based on timing.
